circuit.name: Buck DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Step-down DC-DC converter using a NMOS high-side switch, freewheeling diode,  inductor, and output capacitor. Steps down 12V input to 5V output at 0.5A load. NMOS is driven with active-high PWM logic.

requirements.requirement: Meet target Vout across line (Vin) and load changes

data.name: Vout_avg
data.description: Average output voltage (window chosen by the generator).

data.name: Vout_ripple_vpp
data.description: Peak-to-peak ripple of the output voltage.

data.name: Vin_avg
data.description: Average input voltage (window chosen by the generator).

data.name: Iout_avg
data.description: Average load current (sign convention handled by generator).

requirements.requirement: Dynamic response: step changes (line/load) with minimal overshoot and fast settling

environment.description: Time domain simulation settings; t_step is the absolute time of the applied step used by TRIG AT= for settling/rise-time measures.

data.name: Vout_max
data.description: Maximum VOUT during the transient window.

data.name: Vout_min
data.description: Minimum VOUT during the transient window.

data.name: rise_time_10_90
data.spice_command: TRIG [VOUT] VAL={0.1*{criteria.target_vout}} RISE=1 TARG [VOUT] VAL={0.9*{criteria.target_vout}} RISE=1
data.description: Rise time from 10% to 90% of target voltage

data.name: settle_to_upper
data.description: Time to settle to upper band

data.name: settle_to_lower
data.description: Time to settle to lower band

data.name: IL_peak
data.description: Peak inductor current during the transient.

data.name: IL_ripple
data.description: Peak-to-peak inductor current in steady state.

data.name: Vsw_overshoot
data.description: Max switch-node voltage during/after the step.
